tooltip.tupenter.grace_period: Delay after closing chat before keybind works (to prevent accidental resend)
tooltip.tupenter.rapid_resend_delay: How long to wait before rapid firing starts (Press & Hold only).
tooltip.tupenter.resend_delay: Delay between each resend (0 = As fast as possible).
tooltip.tupenter.history_depth: Number of recent matching messages to resend sequentially.
tooltip.tupenter.resend_mode: Choose between holding the key or toggling on/off
tooltip.tupenter.resend_order: Order in which history items are resent.
tooltip.tupenter.resend_filter: Choose what types of messages to resend
tooltip.tupenter.remember_last_valid: Keep using the last valid message if the new one is filtered out
tooltip.tupenter.record_history: If disabled, new messages will not be added to the resend history.
tooltip.tupenter.update_in_toggle: If OFF, sending new messages won't change what is being spammed
tooltip.tupenter.resend_amount: How many times to send the message every tick (Speed Multiplier). Higher = Faster.
tooltip.tupenter.use_permanent_message: If ON, sends the configured list of messages instead of your history.
tooltip.tupenter.permanent_messages: List of messages/commands to send when triggering.
